text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Same four initial physical cue offsets, three native sizes. The cue remains on throughout 0–1000; withdrawal is not shown.
Dotted heading lines mark the actual targets. R < 0.1 produces heading gaps; no phase is joined across cancellation.
The smallest-size antipodal heading switch is symmetry-constrained and passes through a weak resultant; it is not a measured finite rapid rotation.
Native clock: linear 0–0.1, logarithmic thereafter. All initial overlaps retained; exact cue-footprint overlap and sample intervals are exported.
